title: Machine learning assisted classification of periodontal health and periodontitis using alveolar bone loss measurements on bitewing radiographs.
summary: 1,537 of 2,162 bitewing radiographs included; alveolar bone loss measured and calibrated by examiners (κ=.94); Random Forest validation accuracy 96.4%, unseen test accuracy 92%, AUC .99/.97.
ai_technology: Specific periodontal health classifier with a previously unseen test dataset; screening utility remains prospective.
